intro: SYSTEM: Body transfer ready. Destination: the microscopic circuits inside OMEGA-99.
GLITCH-0: Upload me. If the core is rewriting our world, I will stop it from the inside.
Your body dissolves into a stream of light. Copper traces become highways. A single microchip becomes an entire world.
OMEGA-99: Unauthorized life detected. Deploying red-eye sentinels.
Survive shifting conveyor sectors and red laser barriers. Match the Lucky Rules and reach the heart of the circuit.
ending: SYSTEM: Sector 30 secured. The Virus has been erased. Super Com is defeated.
GLITCH-0: We did it together. The circuit is free, and our assistants are coming home.
A new signal crosses the network. Will you keep protecting the system? Choose YES for Infinite mode.
